lines.en: label harukacamp1:
scene harukanightbond1
: Hey. Mind if I join you?
lines.zh: : 嘿。介意我坐下吗？

lines.en: : Well, well, well. Look who finally decided to give me the time of day.
lines.zh: : 哎哟喂。看看是谁终于肯赏脸见我了。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure we’ve already crossed over to the time of night, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 我很确定我们已经跨进夜里了，Haruka。

lines.en: : Then that just goes to show you how long you’ve been avoiding me.
lines.zh: : 那正好说明你已经躲了我多久。

lines.en: : I’m not intentionally avoiding you. I just-
lines.zh: : 我不是故意躲你。我只是——

lines.en: scene harukanightbond2
: I know. I’m not hunting for an apology or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我不是在讨道歉之类的。

lines.en: : You were sort of a last minute addition to this trip in the first place, so it’s not like I’d been looking forward to spending time with you for weeks on end or whatever.
lines.zh: : 你本来就是这趟旅行的临时追加人选，所以我也没有好几个星期一直盼着跟你待在一起什么的。

lines.en: : Besides, you’ve got enough going on with Ami. If leaving me out of the equation helps you balance things out, so be it.
lines.zh: : 再说，你跟 Ami 之间的事已经够多了。如果把我排除在外能帮你平衡过来，那就这样吧。

lines.en: scene harukanightbond3
: I can wait a little longer.
lines.zh: : 我可以再等一会儿。

lines.en: : Bold claim for someone who gets lonely the second no one’s looking at her.
lines.zh: : 对一个没人看她一秒就会寂寞的人来说，这话可真大胆。

lines.en: : It’s a little easier when the people I want to look at me aren’t in space.
lines.zh: : 如果我想让对方看我的那个人不在太空里，那就容易多了。

lines.en: : Your poor husband.
lines.zh: : 你那可怜的丈夫。

lines.en: : Don’t bring him up right now. Let’s talk about {i}you.{/i} How did things go with your potentially demonic niece? You guys were gone for a while.
lines.zh: : 现在别提他。我们聊聊{i}你{/i}吧。你那个可能是恶魔的侄女怎么样了？你们去了挺久。

lines.en: scene harukanightbond4
: Pretty good actually...
lines.zh: : 其实还不错……

lines.en: : Apparently, she was already looking at me like some sort of father figure. And it was just {i}me{/i} who was holding that back from turning into anything bigger.
lines.zh: : 看来，她早就把我当成某种父亲一样的存在了。只是一直是{i}我{/i}在阻止它更进一步。

lines.en: : I’m not surprised, really. With the way that girl talks about you, I had a hard time {i}ever{/i} believing you were {i}just{/i} her uncle.
lines.zh: : 我真不意外。看那女孩谈起你的样子，我{i}一直{/i}很难相信你{i}「只是」{/i}她的叔叔。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:

: Of course, the fact that she very openly called me out on being an unfaithful slut may have played a part in me thinking she might like you a {i}little{/i} more than a standard relative. But I digress.
lines.zh: : 当然，她非常直白地骂我是个不忠的荡妇，这件事可能也让我觉得，她对你的喜欢比普通亲戚要多{i}「一点」{/i}。不过我跑题了。

lines.en: : And I digress {i}because{/i} I am an unfaithful slut.
lines.zh: : 而我跑题，是{i}因为{/i}我就是个不忠的荡妇。

lines.en: : But you’re {i}my{/i} unfaithful slut and that is precisely why I keep you around.
lines.zh: : 可你是{i}「我的」{/i}不忠荡妇，而这正是我留着你的原因。

lines.en: : I’d be quite offended to hear that if it weren’t for the fact that being degraded turns me on.
lines.zh: : 要不是被羞辱会让我兴奋，我听了大概会很生气。

lines.en: scene harukanightbond2
: But I digress again.
lines.zh: : 不过我又跑题了。

lines.en: else:
: What gave it away?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么看出来的？

lines.en: scene harukanightbond2

: One of the many conversations I’ve overheard at the cafe where she talked about having your babies. Which isn’t really a thing someone should do with their father either. But hey, I’ve got some weird kinks too.
lines.zh: : 我在咖啡馆里无意中听到的许多对话之一——她说想给你生孩子。这也不是谁该跟自己父亲做的事。不过嘿，我也有奇怪的癖好。

lines.en: : You think things will get better from here on out?
lines.zh: : 你觉得从现在开始会好起来吗？

lines.en: : Better how?
lines.zh: : 好起来是指？

lines.en: : Like...do you think reevaluating your relationship with Ami will help you eventually find happiness outside of what your students keep beneath their skirts?
lines.zh: : 比如……你觉得重新审视你和 Ami 的关系，能帮你最终在学生裙底之外找到幸福吗？

lines.en: scene harukanightbond5
: Maybe. But it’s not really my happiness I’m concerned about. I just want Ami to stop blaming herself for not being able to break my concrete shoes off as I slowly descend to the ocean floor.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。可我担心的其实不是我自己的幸福。我只想让 Ami 别再自责——怪自己没能砸开我的水泥鞋，眼睁睁看着我慢慢沉入海底。

lines.en: : Don’t you think that goes both ways, though?
lines.zh: : 可你不觉得这是双向的吗？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean...she knows you better than anyone, doesn’t she? Which means she probably wants you to stop blaming yourself for the things that are drowning {i}her.{/i} You’re doing the same thing.
lines.zh: : 我是说……她比任何人都了解你，不是吗？也就是说，她大概也希望你能别再为那些正在把{i}她{/i}淹死的事自责。你在做同样的事。

lines.en: : But in my case, I’m actually making mistakes. And she’s-
lines.zh: : 可我的情况是真的在犯错。而她——

lines.en: : Making mistakes too. She’s only human, Sensei. And making mistakes is what humans do.
lines.zh: : 也在犯错。她只是个普通人，Sensei。而犯错就是人会做的事。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
: Like, just look at {i}us.{/i} Our entire relationship is a mistake. But it’s not like that’s stopping me from enjoying it while it lasts.
lines.zh: : 比如，就看看{i}我们俩{/i}吧。我们的整段关系就是个错误。可这也没妨碍我趁着它还在的时候好好享受。

lines.en: else:

: Like, just look at me. I practically threw myself at you not long after we first met and I’m already spoken for. But you’re one of my best friends now, and that wouldn’t have happened {i}without{/i} that mistake. You know?
lines.zh: : 比如，就看看我。我们刚认识不久我就几乎把自己送到你面前了，而我早就名花有主。可你现在是我最好的朋友之一，而如果{i}没有{/i}那个错误，这一切都不会发生。你知道吗？

lines.en: : I know. But still...she’s just a girl. She shouldn’t have to be thinking about all of this depressing shit so early in her life. So all I want to do now is try and...save her a little bit of anguish.
lines.zh: : 我知道。可还是……她只是个孩子。她不该在这么小的时候就去想这些压抑的事。所以我现在只想试着……替她省掉一点痛苦。

lines.en: : Is that really {i}all{/i} you want to do, though?
lines.zh: : 可这真的是你{i}唯一{/i}想做的事吗？

lines.en: scene harukanightbond6
: Is there something else you think I should want?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我还该想要别的什么吗？

lines.en: : I mean...you’re still kind of unemployed, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 我是说……你算是还在失业中，对吧？

lines.en: : Rin says it’s been aeons since you’ve shown up at school. And I doubt spending so much time alone is doing much for your mental health, so...don’t you want to change at least {i}that?{/i}
lines.zh: : Rin 说你已经很久很久没去学校了。我也不觉得一个人待那么久对精神状态有什么好处，所以……至少{i}这一点{/i}你不想改变吗？

lines.en: scene harukanightbond7
: Silence speaks volumes sometimes, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 有时候沉默胜于千言万语，Sensei。

lines.en: : You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……

lines.en: : I think there was a time where I actually kind of enjoyed teaching. But, knowing me, I don’t really believe any of it was for the same reasons other people get into the field.
lines.zh: : 我觉得曾经有一段时间，我是真的挺喜欢教书的。不过，以我对自己的了解，我不认为其中的任何一个理由，和别人进入这行的理由相同。

lines.en: : Like...the girl who’s filling in for me right now. She seems to really love all of the girls in the class and she’s only known them a fraction of the time I have. It’s easy to tell that she, like...wants to make a difference.
lines.zh: : 比如……现在替我代课的那个女孩。她看起来真的很爱班上的所有女孩，而她认识她们的时间只有我的几分之一。很容易看出来她……想带来一些改变。

lines.en: : So even if she got into teaching for the wrong reasons, it’s the right ones that are keeping her around. And that’s...pretty obviously not how it was for me since you already know what I’m doing with some of those girls.
lines.zh: : 所以就算她入行的理由不对，让她留下来的理由也是对的。而这……显然不是我的情况，毕竟你已经知道我在跟其中一些女孩做什么了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you’ve neglected to tell me why you got into teaching in the first place. What do you mean by saying it wasn’t for the same reasons other people get into it?
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你一直没告诉我，你当初到底为什么去教书。你说理由和别人不一样，是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean...I can only guess how I was feeling back then.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我只能猜测自己当时的感受。

lines.en: scene harukanightbond8
: But I’m pretty sure it was to try and prevent anyone from winding up like me.
lines.zh: : 不过我很确定，是为了尽量不让别人变成我这样。

lines.en: : I...don’t really get it. You decided to mentor people so...they {i}wouldn’t{/i} wind up like you? Isn’t that kind of backwards?
lines.zh: : 我……不太懂。你决定去当别人的导师，好让他们……{i}不要{/i}变成你这样？这不是有点反了吗？

lines.en: : Maybe I worded that incorrectly. What I mean is more that...
lines.zh: : 也许我用词不当。我的意思更像是……

lines.en: : There are certain ways you’re meant to act in this world. And doing things to set yourself apart from others is generally discouraged.
lines.zh: : 在这个世界上，有些「应该」的行为方式。而做任何让自己与众不同的事，通常是不被鼓励的。

lines.en: : But there are some of us who really want to do things like that and can’t seem to figure out how.
lines.zh: : 可我们中的一些人真的很想那么做，却怎么也搞不明白该怎么做。

lines.en: : We want to fit in and we want to seem {i}normal.{/i} But we’re products of the way we’re brought up and, a lot of the time, we never have the chance to understand what we’re meant to do in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我们想融入，想显得「{i}正常{/i}」。可我们是成长环境的产物，很多时候，我们从未有机会弄明白自己到底该做什么。

lines.en: : I think what I wanted is to take what I’ve learned and share that with people experiencing something similar. So they don’t wind up roaming through life confused or lost like I did for so long before just...giving up.
lines.zh: : 我想我当初想要的，是把我学到的东西分享给有相似经历的人。好让他们不至于像我那样，在人生里迷茫地游荡那么久，最后干脆……放弃了。

lines.en: scene harukanightbond9
: Wow...
: I think that’s the most I’ve ever heard you say at once.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这是我有史以来听你说过最长的一段话。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...I’m sorry it all probably sounded like nonsense.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个……抱歉，大概听起来全是胡话。

lines.en: scene harukanightbond10
: Not at all. In fact, I think gaining this sort of...insight into your allegedly {i}misguided{/i} mind explains a lot really.
lines.zh: : 一点也不。事实上，我觉得能这样……窥见你那据说{i}「误入歧途」{/i}的内心，真的解释了很多事。

lines.en: : I’ve never thought you were normal or anything like that. Which might sound like an insult, but it’s really not. And I think that’s why people like Rin and I gravitate to you because we’re not {i}normal{/i} either.
lines.zh: : 我从来没觉得你正常什么的。这听起来像在骂你，其实不是。我想这就是为什么我和 Rin 这样的人会被你吸引——因为我们也不{i}正常{/i}。

lines.en: : Yeah but, in that sense, nobody is really {i}normal.{/i} And yeah, Rin’s an orphan — but I’d wager you had a pretty standard upbringing. Am I right?
lines.zh: : 是啊，可这么说的话，没有谁是真的「{i}正常{/i}」的。而且，Rin 是孤儿——不过我敢打赌，你的成长经历相当标准。我说得对吗？

lines.en: : More or less.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。

lines.en: scene harukanightbond11
: I did well in school. I had parents who fed me and put a roof over my head. The whole nine yards. And I sure as hell never slept with any teachers like Sara did.
lines.zh: : 我在学校成绩不错。父母供我吃穿、给我遮风挡雨。应有尽有。而且我他妈肯定没像 Sara 那样跟老师上过床。

lines.en: : But look at me now, Sensei. Like, sure- I’m a somewhat successful business owner. I’ve got a roof over my head and a car and a group of friends I can go camping with on random Sundays whenever I want.
lines.zh: : 可看看现在的我，Sensei。是啊，我是个还算成功的店主。我有房、有车，还有一群可以随时在某个周日一起去露营的朋友。

lines.en: if harukapredator == False:
: But I’m insanely lonely. I’m a borderline nymphomaniac. I send naked pictures of myself to teenage girls and pretend I never meant to.
lines.zh: : 可我孤独得发疯。我是个近乎 nymphomaniac 的人。我给十几岁的女孩发自拍裸照，还装作不是故意的。

lines.en: else:
: But I’m also a predator who will not only bend to your each and every desire, but eat out teenage girls on beaches and finger myself to fantasies about you fucking my friends’ daughters.
lines.zh: : 可我也是个捕食者——我不仅会屈从于你的每一个欲望，还会在海滩上舔十几岁的女孩，并一边自慰一边幻想你操我朋友的女儿。

lines.en: : And I do all of that {i}with{/i} my “standard upbringing.” So maybe that’s less responsible for the way you are than you think. Just some food for thought.
lines.zh: : 而这一切，我都是{i}带着{/i}「标准的成长经历」做出来的。所以也许它对你之所以是你的影响，并没有你想的那么大。随便想想吧。

lines.en: : Fair point, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 说得有道理，Haruka。

lines.en: : I can be pretty smart when I want to. Not just anyone can set their sights on opening a cafe when they’re a kid and then actually follow through with it.
lines.zh: : 我想聪明的时候还是挺聪明的。不是谁都能在小时候就立志开一家咖啡馆，然后真的做到的。

lines.en: : You’ve wanted that cafe since you were a kid?
lines.zh: : 你从小的梦想就是那家咖啡馆？

lines.en: : It was practically my dream.
lines.zh: : 那几乎就是我的梦想。

lines.en: : I remember this one project we had to do in school one year where we needed to come up with a whole-ass business proposal. You know — blueprints...logo...everything.
lines.zh: : 我记得有一年学校有个作业，要我们写出一份完整的商业企划。你知道的——蓝图……商标……所有东西。

lines.en: : And my pitch was basically Koi Cafe. Just, back then I think I called it Rainbow Cafe or...Sunflower Cafe or something like that. It was girly. That’s all I really remember.
lines.zh: : 而我交的方案基本上就是 Koi Cafe。只不过那时候我好像叫它 Rainbow Cafe 或者……Sunflower Cafe 什么的。很女孩子气。我能记起来的就这些。

lines.en: : But, years later when I was less into pink and more into coffee, I rethought the base concept and landed on Koi instead.
lines.zh: : 不过多年以后，我不再那么迷粉色、转而迷上了咖啡，于是重新思考了最初的概念，最后定在了 Koi。

lines.en: : As in “love?”
lines.zh: : 是「恋」的那个意思？

lines.en: : As in the fish, actually.
lines.zh: : 其实是鲤鱼的那种鱼。

lines.en: scene harukanightbond12
: Koi fish are linked to all sorts of symbolism because they’re beautiful and easy to, like...be poetic about, I guess. But to me, they’ve always stood for accomplishment. Or courage. Strength, even.
lines.zh: : 鲤鱼被赋予了各种各样的象征意义，因为它们很美，而且很容易……怎么说，让人诗兴大发吧。不过对我来说，它们一直代表着成就。或者勇气。甚至是力量。

lines.en: : And, I’m sure you’ve noticed this by now, but I’m kind of an overly sensitive piece of shit drama queen sometimes.
lines.zh: : 而且，我敢肯定你早就注意到了，我有时候是个过于敏感的狗屎戏精。

lines.en: : So choosing a symbol for the qualities I lack seemed like a way for me to trick myself into believing I might actually have them, you know?
lines.zh: : 所以，选一个象征着我缺乏的品质的符号，看起来像是能骗自己相信我也许真的拥有它们的方式，你懂吧？

lines.en: : I guess I never realized how much thought went into it. I always just saw it as some...normal cafe.
lines.zh: : 我想我从没意识到这里面倾注了多少心思。我一直只把它当成一家……普通的咖啡馆。

lines.en: : It is! But it’s {i}my{/i} normal cafe.
lines.zh: : 它就是！可它是{i}「我的」{/i}普通咖啡馆。

lines.en: scene harukanightbond13
: It’s the symbol of all that hard work paying off. An actual, physical {i}thing{/i} that embodies the...great accomplishment of a girl my age {i}winning.{/i}
lines.zh: : 它象征着所有努力终于有了回报。一个实实在在、看得见摸得着的{i}「东西」{/i}，体现着我这个年纪的女孩{i}「赢下来」{/i}这项了不起的成就。

lines.en: : I never won at much when I was younger, Sensei. But I also never really had {i}time{/i} to win because I was thinking so much about the future.
lines.zh: : 我小时候从没在什么事上赢过，Sensei。可我也从来没有「{i}时间{/i}」去赢，因为我把太多心思花在了未来上。

lines.en: : I don’t have to do that anymore because I {i}like{/i} where I am. But, at the same time...
lines.zh: : 现在我不用再那样了，因为我{i}喜欢{/i}自己现在的位置。可与此同时……

lines.en: scene harukanightbond14
: It’s things like this that make me worry about you since you don’t {i}have{/i} anything like that to remind you of all you’ve had to go through to get here.
lines.zh: : 就是这些事让我担心你，因为你{i}没有{/i}类似的东西，来提醒你为了走到今天都经历了些什么。

lines.en: : You {i}had{/i} the school. You {i}had{/i} your class. But now, you’re letting all of that drift away because you lost sight of why it was ever important to you in the first place.
lines.zh: : 你{i}曾经{/i}有学校。你{i}曾经{/i}有你的班级。可现在，你让这一切都慢慢漂走了，因为你忘了它最初对你到底为什么重要。

lines.en: : So maybe stop seeing it as a training ground for corrupting today’s youth and {i}start{/i} seeing it as a place where you {i}can{/i} connect with the people you want to connect with. Just like you used to.
lines.zh: : 所以也许该停止把它当成「腐化当代青年的训练场」，而{i}开始{/i}把它看成一个你{i}能{/i}与想建立联系的人建立联系的地方。就像从前一样。

lines.en: : One thing I’ve learned from my time in the service industry is that {i}everyone{/i} has problems, Sensei. And some people like talking about those problems {i}way{/i} too much.
lines.zh: : 我在服务业待了这么久学到的一件事是，{i}每个人{/i}都有烦恼，Sensei。而有些人{i}实在{/i}太喜欢谈论那些烦恼了。

lines.en: : But what that really means is that there’s always someone who will need what you have to offer.
lines.zh: : 可这真正意味着的是，总会有人需要你能提供的东西。

lines.en: : And for me, that’s coffee.
lines.zh: : 而对我来说，那就是咖啡。

lines.en: : It’s a place for people to relax or refuel to prepare themselves for the hell that lies outside of my doors.
lines.zh: : 它是一个让人们放松或补充能量、好为门外那片地狱做准备的地方。

lines.en: scene harukanightbond15
: And for you, it’s...
lines.zh: : 而对你来说，它是……

lines.en: : Actually...what subject do you even teach?
lines.zh: : 等等……你到底教什么科目？

lines.en: : All of them.
lines.zh: : 全部。

lines.en: : {i}All{/i} of them? Is that how they’re doing things over there now?
lines.zh: : {i}全部{/i}？现在那边都是这么搞的吗？

lines.en: : It might just be a budget thing, but...I just want to say — I think that was one of the most helpful things you or...anyone else has ever said to me.
lines.zh: : 也许只是预算问题，不过……我只想说——我觉得这是你、或者……任何其他人跟我说过的最有帮助的话之一。

lines.en: : Like I said, I can be pretty smart when I want to. You probably just forget that since I’m always hanging out with Maki and Sara.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，我想聪明的时候还是挺聪明的。你大概只是忘了，因为我总是跟 Maki 和 Sara 混在一起。

lines.en: : Haruka.
lines.zh: : Haruka。

lines.en: : Hm?
: I’m really proud of you.
lines.zh: : 我真的为你骄傲。

lines.en: scene harukanightbond16
: You really have done a lot to be proud of. And I’m glad you have something that serves as physical proof of that.
lines.zh: : 你真的做了很多值得骄傲的事。我很高兴你有一样东西，能作为这一切的实物证明。

lines.en: : Thank...you...
: No problem. But why do you look so embarrassed all of a sudden when you just spent the last ten minutes essentially giving yourself the same compliment?
lines.zh: : 不客气。不过你刚才十分钟基本都在给自己同样的夸奖，怎么突然这么不好意思？

lines.en: scene harukanightbond17
: It’s different when it comes from someone else, obviously. Especially someone you look up to.
lines.zh: : 这当然是不同的，当它出自别人之口的时候。尤其是出自你仰视的人。

lines.en: : Sure, but you only look up to me because I can get all of the girls that you can only dream of getting.
lines.zh: : 是吗，可你仰视我只是因为那些你做梦都睡不到的女孩我都能睡到。

lines.en: scene harukanightbond18
: There are other things too, you know!
lines.zh: : 还有别的原因呢，好不好！

lines.en: : Like what?
lines.zh: : 比如？

lines.en: : Like...the fact that you can withstand multiple apparent traumas when most people get taken out of commission by just one!
lines.zh: : 比如……你能承受多重显而易见的创伤，而大多数人只要一次就被击垮了！

lines.en: : Haruka, I was {i}just{/i} stuck inside of my house for months. You shouldn’t look up to me just because I’m voluntarily stepping back out into the sun again.
lines.zh: : Haruka，我{i}只是{/i}被困在自己家里几个月而已。你不该因为我自愿重新走到阳光下就仰视我。

lines.en: : That was just one more thing! There’s also the part where...you’re caring! And cool!
lines.zh: : 那只是一件事而已！还有……你很体贴！而且很酷！

lines.en: : In fact, practically {i}everyone{/i} looks up to you even though they probably shouldn’t!
lines.zh: : 事实上，几乎{i}所有人{/i}都仰视你，尽管他们大概不该这样！

lines.en: : You’re right. They should be looking up to you instead.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。他们该仰视的是你才对。

lines.en: scene harukanightbond19
: Ugh...{i}no.{/i} That’s wrong too. And it’s not what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}不是{/i}。那也不对。而且我不是这个意思。

lines.en: : What I mean is more like...how do I even put this?
lines.zh: : 我的意思更像是……我该怎么说呢？

lines.en: scene harukanightbond20
: What I mean is that...it’s just kind of embarrassing hearing you say things like that since I never really...contemplated getting that sort of validation from you.
lines.zh: : 我是说……听到你说这种话，有点让人不好意思，因为我从来没……想过会从你这里得到那种认可。

lines.en: : It’s just surprising, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 只是有点意外，就这样。

lines.en: scene harukanightbond21
: But...it makes me really happy.
lines.zh: : 不过……我真的很开心。

lines.en: : Almost happy enough to forget that you spent the first half of today hanging out with literally everyone else.
lines.zh: : 开心到几乎能忘掉你今天前半段是跟其他所有人一起度过的。

lines.en: : Yeah...sorry about that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……抱歉。

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll make sure to drop by the cafe again soon, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我一定会尽快再去咖啡馆坐坐的。

lines.en: : Make sure it’s when I’m working...
lines.zh: : 记得挑我上班的时候……

lines.en: : I can show you how it compares to my old blueprint.
lines.zh: : 我可以给你看看它跟我当年那份蓝图比起来怎么样。

lines.en: Haruka pours some coffee into small paper cups that the two of us sip from for the next fifteen minutes or so while lazily gazing up at the stars.
lines.zh: Haruka 把咖啡倒进小纸杯里，接下来的十五分钟左右，我们一边小口喝着，一边懒洋洋地仰望星空。

lines.en: You can see so many of them out here.
lines.zh: 在这里能看到那么多的星星。

lines.en: And for once, it almost doesn’t hurt to look at them.
lines.zh: 而这一次，看着它们几乎不再让人心痛。

lines.en: if harukasex == False:
Haruka rests her head on my shoulder, but not in the way that would make it seem like she wants me more than she actually does.
lines.zh: Haruka 把头靠在我肩上，却不是那种让人觉得她比实际上更想要我的靠法。

lines.en: I think she’s just happy to be here beside me.
lines.zh: 我想她只是很高兴能陪在我身边。

lines.en: And I think that if I put my arm around her now that she’ll interpret it the same.
lines.zh: 我想如果我现在伸手搂住她，她也会以同样的方式理解。

lines.en: And so I do.
lines.zh: 于是我这样做了。

lines.en: And so she does.
lines.zh: 于是她也照做了。

lines.en: And we both close our eyes.
lines.zh: 然后我们都闭上了眼睛。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
But when I open mine another ten minutes later after dozing, I notice she’s gone.
lines.zh: 可十分钟后，我打了个盹再睁开眼，发现她已经不见了。

lines.en: And so I must go as well.
lines.zh: 所以我也该走了。

lines.en: $ harukacamp1 = True
$ haruka_love +=1
{i}Haruka’s affection has increased to [haruka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Haruka 的好感度提升到了 [haruka_love]!{/i}

lines.en: What now?
lines.zh: 现在该怎么办？

lines.en: jump campmenu2
else:
Haruka rests her head on my shoulder.
lines.zh: Haruka 把头靠在我肩上。

lines.en: Several minutes later, she looks up at me- silently asking for something else.
lines.zh: 几分钟后，她抬头看着我——无声地索求着别的什么。

lines.en: But it’s something I can not give her here.
lines.zh: 可那是我在这儿给不了她的东西。

lines.en: It wouldn’t feel right beneath the magpies.
lines.zh: 在喜鹊底下做那种事，感觉不对。

$ harukacamp1 = True
$ haruka_love += 1
{i}Haruka’s affection has increased to [haruka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Haruka 的好感度提升到了 [haruka_love]!{/i}

lines.en: What should I do now?
lines.zh: 现在我该怎么办？
